title: derby01: shared shapes
description: Points, lines, polygons, headings, colours and car-local positions that the other schemas use. The map is in metres: x runs east, z runs south, the middle of the town is near (0, 0) and everything stays within 400 m of it.

x.description: Metres east (+) or west (-) of the middle of the map.

z.description: Metres south (+) or north (-) of the middle of the map.

point.description: A point on the map: [x, z] in metres, x east, z south.

line.description: A line through points on the map, in order.

poly.description: A polygon: its corners in order, either way round.

yaw.description: A heading in radians: 0 faces +z (south), 1.5708 faces +x (east), 3.1416 faces north.

id.description: An id: lower-case letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.

local.description: A position on the car in metres: [x, y, z] with x to the car's left, y up from the ground and z forward from its middle.

prefixItems.description: Metres to the car's left (+) or right (-).
Metres forward (+) or back (-) from the middle of the car.

offset.description: An offset from the part's own position, in metres: [left, up, forward].

prefixItems.description: Metres to the left (+) or right (-).

seconds.description: A span of time: [shortest, longest] in seconds. A value is picked at random between them each time.
